CustomField.description: The answer scale for a Likert Matrix section in Number mode, as ordered columns. Each column has a label (the column header), a value (the number saved to the row's field when chosen) and optional help shown as a tooltip. Edited with the scale editor in Form Builder and stored as JSON. Ignored in Picklist mode, where the columns come from the picklist's options.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Defines your Number-mode answer scale as ordered columns of label, stored number, and optional help text. Edit it with the scale editor in Form Builder rather than by hand; in Picklist mode this is ignored because the columns come from your picklist's options.
CustomField.label: Likert Scale
